integrity: The proof uses the printed differential equations and reset relations; the numerical roots are evaluations of the proved monotone scalar inequality. Related literature was compared at the level of model, trigger, reset, period statements, and implication.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on existence of a strictly positive order-one periodic orbit and does not classify higher-order cycles.
The release-corrected inequality is unconditional within that scope, but the unique-root period floor requires rho >= lambda tau/(h+tau).
No claim of sharpness is made.
title: A predator-release-corrected intervention-frequency ceiling for a ratio-dependent impulsive cycle
